author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.38 shipped: HOTFIX: Coordinator Manager failed to start in 5.103.37
summary: HOTFIX: Coordinator Manager failed to start in 5.103.37
why: v5.103.37 moved coordinator registration onto a shared helper but evaluated it before cm_config was assigned in async_setup_entry; the 15:55 restart raised UnboundLocalError and every domain coordinator (energy, HVAC, presence, safety, security) stayed down. Two-line ordering fix plus an AST regression test that fails on the broken code.
implications: Shipped CM-COORDINATORS-ADD-ONE-BY-ONE-1 at v5.103.38; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.38.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: If any coordinator fails to register after this restart, add an async_setup_entry harness test with the master switch on (the gap that let this through).

refs.release_notes: Compute the coordinator registration set after cm_config is built; v5.103.37 raised UnboundLocalError at startup so no domain coordinator ran.
